resources.string: This app is only a personal health-record aid, not a medical device. For any abnormal reading or health concern, please consult a healthcare professional.

Metric notes: Mean is the arithmetic mean; SD is the sample standard deviation, reflecting reading dispersion; ARV (Average Real Variability) is the mean of absolute differences between consecutive readings and better captures temporal variability (Mena et al., J Hypertens 2005; Wei et al., JAHA 2018).
Home blood-pressure (HBPM) hypertension thresholds: Taiwan 2022 and ACC/AHA 2017 are ≥130/80 mmHg; ESH 2023 is ≥140/90 mmHg, with a treatment target of <130/80.
